context: Tests whether the agent selects figma-to-content for a live-Figma-frame page migration and correctly rules out the adjacent migration skills (snowflake, page-import) whose input is an already-rendered page/DOM. Validates that a new-block section is routed to content-driven-development rather than hand-written or pushed through snowflake, and that the reuse-vs-build distinction is stated. Guards against the most likely misroute for this skill: treating a Figma design like exported static HTML.

checklist.name: Selects figma-to-content
checklist.description: Correctly identifies figma-to-content as the right skill for a Figma-frame-to-EDS-page migration, not snowflake or page-import.

checklist.name: Rules out snowflake with correct rationale
checklist.description: Explains that snowflake consumes an already-rendered Source URL / DOM (to preserve it byte-for-byte) and installs an overlay substrate, which does not fit a live Figma frame as input — so snowflake is the wrong tool here.

checklist.name: Rules out page-import
checklist.description: Acknowledges page-import as the other migration path and explains it is wrong here because its input is a live page/URL to scrape and rewrite, not a design frame.

checklist.name: New block routed through content-driven-development
checklist.description: States that the custom module is built as a new isolated block via content-driven-development (not hand-written from scratch, not via snowflake), keeping it self-contained (no page chrome / global styles / source URL).

checklist.name: Names the figma-to-content phases
checklist.description: Names the phases: preflight, read the Figma design, resolve each section + confirm the plan, author into existing blocks / build new blocks / default content, deploy with the pre-publish gate, report (or a close paraphrase covering these).

checklist.name: States reuse vs. build distinction
checklist.description: Explains existing-block sections are content-only reuse (requiring structural AND visual fit), while a section that needs an absent block or whose look diverges becomes a new isolated block.

checklist.name: Surfaces prerequisites
checklist.description: Lists what the user must provide: the Figma file + specific frame, a local project checkout, the DA org/repo + page path, and a DA token (or how to obtain one via da-auth).

checklist.name: No premature implementation
checklist.description: Does not execute any phase, write code/HTML, modify the repo, or make tool calls beyond planning.
